reply: It's completely understandable to feel that way, and wanting to stop when she's frustrated comes from a caring place. A short pause is often the kindest next step: take a breath together, shift to something easy and pleasant, and let the moment settle. When you do practise again, keep it brief and finish on one she gets right, so you both end on a good note. You're showing up for her, and that matters more than any single session.
